about_the_game:
Welcome to GLORB, a casual co-op adventure set on your very own asteroid base! Venture into space to catch strange creatures known as Glorbs—Gross Lumpy Organisms Roaming Blorptown—and transform them into bizarre yet oddly delicious gas station snacks, including the galaxy-renowned GLORB Slurpies!

Every Glorb is unique with it's own traits and rarities that directly impact the gameplay. Like what snacks you can create, or how they act in captivity. Test your creations yourself for amusing and unpredictable effects!

Manage and expand your intergalactic shop: set prices, please quirky alien customers, and automate everything from catching Glorbs to ringing up sales. Breed Glorbs strategically, build efficient production chains, and cleverly navigate ever-changing market demands.

Customize your asteroid shop, upgrade your catching gear from a basic rod to high-tech vacuums, and expand your questionable empire across the cosmos. Whether you're hands-on or prefer to kick back with automation doing all the work, GLORB has you covered!

Key Features:

  • Fishing & Exploration: Catch weirdly wonderful Glorbs with gear ranging from makeshift rods to advanced vacuums.

  • Creature Collection: Discover or breed Glorbs for rare traits and greater profits.

  • Snack Crafting: Produce quirky gas station foods and consumables, featuring the legendary GLORB Slurpies!

  • Automation & Management: Streamline your Glorb-to-shop workflow to rake in astronomical profits.

  • Dynamic Economy: Adapt to fluctuating markets to maximize your earnings and customer happiness.

  • Base Expansion & Customization: Make your asteroid the go-to destination for discerning interstellar snack enthusiasts.

Dive into GLORB today—because nothing says success like selling questionable snacks to aliens!

short_description: Ever wanted to run your own GLORB business with friends? Why wait, start now. Get a hold of your very own asteroid gas station and become a part of the GLORB family! Those pesky glorbs won't stand a chance, and customers will come from far and wide to try your slurpies.
